a_friendly_face.name: A Friendly Face
a_friendly_face.text: New in town? Go and say hello to Sister Lune first.
a_friendly_face.done_text: Good. Now you know where to go when you are hurt.

slime_cleanup.name: Slime Cleanup
slime_cleanup.text: Green slimes are eating the meadow flowers. Defeat 8 of them.
slime_cleanup.done_text: The meadow thanks you, and so do I.

sticky_business.name: Sticky Business
sticky_business.text: Slime Jelly sells well in the city. Bring me 5 and I will pay you.
sticky_business.done_text: Lovely and sticky. Here is your share.

blue_trouble.name: Blue Trouble
blue_trouble.text: Blue slimes are pushing out of Mossy Woods. Defeat 6 of them.
blue_trouble.done_text: That will keep them back for a while. Take these stones.

daily_pantry.name: Jelly for the Pantry
daily_pantry.text: Every day: bring me 10 Slime Jelly.
daily_pantry.done_text: My customers can never get enough.
